svg.title: Anatomy of the Liquid Glass
svg.desc: Animated exploded-layer diagram of the GlassDock glass shader. A backdrop snapshot is refracted through a thick beveled capsule, gains chromatic dispersion and frost, then specular key and counter lights with a Fresnel glow, and finally composites with a soft shadow and a moving glint.
svg.text: Five passes inside one fragment shader turn a screenshot into a lens

g.text: Rendered in a GLSL ES 3.0 fragment shader - about 0.15 ms per frame on an Intel Iris Xe
